description: The contracting parties are Collectible Concepts Group, Inc. and Pivotal Self Service Tech, Inc., and the core commercial purpose of the contract is to form a joint venture named MightyCell Batteries for marketing batteries and related products.
The manufacturing agreement is between Stremicks Heritage Foods, LLC and Premier Nutrition Corporation for the production of food products by Heritage for Premier.

The contracting parties are Natalija Tunevic, director of FreeCook, and Mitchell Vitalis, director of Mitchell's Web Advance, PLC, for the purpose of designing and developing a website for the Client.
The contract is between Licensor and Licensee, granting Licensee a non-exclusive license to use the Brand for Permitted Activity, with specific conditions regarding sublicensing and ownership rights.

The contract is between Transporter, which owns and operates a natural gas transportation system, and Customer, who has the right to deliver gas for transportation, under the terms of the Transportation Agreement.
